name: WEX
outlook:
What WEX says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and adjusted net incomeFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue in the range of $760 million to $780 million and adjusted net income in the range of $193 million to $200 million, or $5.67 to $5.87 per diluted share.
  • Full year 2026: revenue and adjusted net incomeFor the full year 2026, the Company now expects revenue in the range of $2.97 billion to $2.99 billion and adjusted net income in the range of $736 million to $743 million, or $21.28 to $21.48 per diluted share, compared to previous guidance for revenue of $2.86 billion to $2.90 billion and adjusted net income of $689 million to $703 million, or $19.68 to $20.08 per diluted share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
